title: Awakening the Sleeper
summary: Break the warders' hold to awaken Kerafyrm in the legacy Sleeper event.
overview: Break the warders' hold to awaken Kerafyrm in the legacy Sleeper event.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare everyone in the zone before the last warder falls, because Kerafyrm's aggression reaches beyond the immediate room.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The wardstone checks for all four warders to be absent before awakening the Sleeper.
The Sleeper is replaced by Kerafyrm, who adds every non-GM player in the zone to his hate list every ten seconds.
Kerafyrm's script removes him after four hours.
The wardstone records an instance-scoped seven-day awakening marker; warder respawns reset that marker and restore the sleeping form.

notes: Approval R017. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Legacy unversioned event only. Confirm deployed wardstone/warder spawn availability versus seasonal and Fabled content; this draft does not describe the separate Fabled Kerafyrm encounter.
